name: Ekaterina Hartlova
source:
The mother of Alex, Sonya, Anya, Tanya and Vasilisa. She is pregnant once again at the start of the game (though the father is unknown). She is a teacher, who is currently unemployed after a scandal where she was caught giving a blowjob to one of her students.

[spoiler]Gave her virginity to her father. She is currently pregnant from Alex.[/spoiler]
